role: HealthKit + archive training queries: VO2max, workout fetch/dedup, archive-authoritative merge, workout route recovery, passive distance, resting HR, ATL/CTL/TSB metrics and weekly training load.

flags.text: mergeArchiveAuthoritative / collapseDuplicates (the archive-vs-HealthKit precedence rule) have no direct test; WorkoutDeduplicationTests covers deduplicateWorkouts only.

units.does: Queries all VO2max samples in the last `days` days ascending by end date (bounded) and returns latest, oldest and count.

branches.cond: HealthKit unavailable or vo2Max type nil

branches.effect: window start falls back to now (empty window)

units.does: Converts samples to ml/kg*min values; nil when none.
Sorts summaries by start and collapses those describing the same session, keeping the richest copy of each cluster.

From index i (the cluster's anchor), absorbs later unconsumed summaries starting within 30 min of the anchor that isSameSession with it (same type within 5 min with intersecting spans, or overlap >= 60 % of the shorter); keeps whichever absorbed copy has the higher data score. Every test is against the anchor, so membership does not depend on which copy currently scores best.
Keeps every archive workout, drops HealthKit workouts overlapping any archive workout by >=60 %, then dedups archive + remaining HealthKit + additional.

The dedup rule: true when a and b are the same type, start within 300 s of each other and their spans intersect (two separate same-type workouts, e.g. an aborted start then the real one, do not), or when they overlap by >= 60 % of the shorter whatever the type or start gap.

branches.effect: true; else falls to the overlap test

units.does: End date = start + durationMinutes*60.
Seconds two workouts' spans share (min end − max start, ends from start + duration); zero or negative when disjoint.
True when the time intersection is >= 60 % of the shorter workout's duration.
Data-richness score: precomputedLoad 8, averageHR 4, maxHR 2, calories 1.
Recent workouts (default 7 days) via fetchWorkouts.
Bounded HKSampleQuery for workouts starting from start-of-day minus `days` to referenceDate (strict start), newest first, mapped to deduplicated summaries; [] on any failure/timeout.
Casts samples to HKWorkout, builds summaries (dropping <1 min) and dedups.
Summary from HKWorkout (start, type, minutes, active kcal, avg/max HR); nil when shorter than 1 minute.
Sum of the workout's activeEnergyBurned statistics in kcal.
Average and max HR (bpm) from the workout's heartRate statistics.
Recovers a GPS route for [start,end] from the best overlapping HealthKit workout's route series, sorted by timestamp.
Bounded query for workouts within [start-15min, end+15min] and picks preferredWorkout among those that actually overlap [start, end].

Among workouts of at least 60 s that overlap [start, end] (a separate workout found only in the query's ±15 min padding is never taken), prefers ones from another source (the Watch) when any exist, and returns the one covering the most of [start, end]; nil when none overlaps.

branches.cond: duration >= 60 and positive overlap with the session

branches.effect: pool = all usable (own source); else external only

units.does: Seconds of `workout` inside [start, end]; zero or negative when disjoint.
Bounded query for the workout's HKWorkoutRoute samples; returns the first.
Bounded HKWorkoutRouteQuery collecting all CLLocations; [] on error or timeout.
Builds an HKWorkoutRouteQuery whose handler accumulates batches under a lock and resolves once on done; resolves nil on error.

branches.effect: return; else resolve with full accumulation

units.does: Appends a batch under the lock and returns the whole accumulation exactly once when done.

branches.effect: nil; else mark resumed and return accumulation

units.does: Bounded HKStatisticsQuery cumulative sum of distanceWalkingRunning in [start,end] (strict start) excluding this app's own samples; 0 on failure.
Bounded limit-1 query for any workout starting in [start,end]; false on failure/timeout.
True when samples non-empty; logs that a sleep merge is skipped.
Extended workouts (default 60 days) via fetchWorkouts.

Newest Apple resting heart rate measured within the last WorkoutLoadRestingHR.maxAgeDays (30) days; with none that recent returns nil so the anchors fall back to the resting-HR setting. A found value is recorded with its sample date into WorkoutLoadRestingHR (memory + UserDefaults).

branches.cond: a sample within the window found
branches.effect: record value + date; else nothing recorded, nil returned

units.does: Latest-ever VO2max value (ml/kg*min).
Value of the newest sample of the type (no date bound), in unit, via latestQuantitySample; nil when none.

Bounded limit-1 newest-first (by end date) sample query, restricted to samples starting at or after `since` when given; returns the value in unit and the sample's end date, nil when none or on error/timeout.
The first sample's quantity in unit and its end date, when it is an HKQuantitySample; nil otherwise.
Resolves HR anchors, merges archive+HealthKit workouts over 180 days, builds daily TRIMP, runs the EWMA through yesterday (morning) or today, and adds VO2max fields.
Anchors = Apple resting HR (newest measured within the last 30 days, fetchAppleRestingHR) else settings effectiveRestingHR; max = settings effectiveMaxHR.
Uses caller anchors; resolves any nil one via trainingHeartRateAnchors.

branches.effect: nil inputs filled from resolved anchors

units.does: Builds TrainingMetrics: today's TRIMP, EWMA point through last day, today's and last-14-day workouts.
Gets HealthKit workouts (preloaded or 180-day fetch) and archive summaries (detached task) and merges archive-authoritatively with additional workouts.

HealthKit + archive workouts merged archive-authoritatively, trimmed to the last `days` calendar days including the reference day (both fetches reach back to the start of the day `days` days ago, one day more).

branches.effect: first day falls back to the reference day's start

units.does: Workouts from the last 14 days, newest first.
Sets vo2MaxLatest and, when a trend exists, 30-day change and sample count.
Daily load buckets from (ewmaEnd - 179 days) through today using TrainingLoadSeries.dailyLoad; logs load sources.
Logs how many in-window workouts are power-backed.

Weekly TrainingLoad: merged workouts of the last `days` calendar days, anchors, ATL/CTL metrics (which already carry VO2max and its 30-day trend from applyVO2Max), then intensity score, days since hard and ACWR; copies the metrics' VO2max, trend change and sample count onto the load (no second VO2 query).
Builds TrainingLoad: weekly score = min(sum intensityScore / days * 7, 100), daysSinceHardWorkout, ACWR from metrics.
